_comment: Single source of truth for the fleet. Everything else in computers/ is
generated from or verified against this file.
JSON rather than YAML on purpose: python3 parses it everywhere, while
PyYAML is missing on the Mac Pro.
Contains addressing only - no keys. See 'Deliberately not in this repo'

machines.name: macpro
machines.hardware: Mac Pro 2013 (MacPro6,1), 12-core Xeon E5 2.7 GHz, 128 GB

machines.name: macbook
machines.hardware: MacBook Pro (Mac17,7), M5 Max, 128 GB unified

machines.name: spark-7ceb
machines.vendor_managed: NVIDIA Sync pins this host in its own ssh_config; do not rename

machines.name: spark-db71
machines.vendor_managed: NVIDIA Sync pins this host in its own ssh_config; do not rename

machines.name: ws1
machines.hardware: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB + RTX 5090 32 GB, 1 TB DDR5
machines.note: Renamed from workstation2deb12 (2026-08-10); that name no longer resolves. Pinned to the LAN IP on purpose: this host also holds 192.168.200.2 on the QSFP fabric, which COLLIDES with spark-7ceb's enp1s0f1np1. mDNS on the Sparks therefore returns the fabric address for ai-workstation.local and lands on the wrong machine. Restore the hostname once the collision is renumbered. Usually powered off.

machines.name: macpro-wan
machines.note: External route to the Mac Pro. Retired once Tailscale is in place.

planned.name: spark-3 / spark-4
planned.note: Cluster extends to 4x GB10 once the QSFP switch arrives
